deviations.what: sap.m.IconTabBar.tabsOverflowMode is @since 1.90 and is the subject of this sample (StartAndEnd), so it is kept 1:1 and the port needs a UI5 runtime >= 1.90.

The controller builds the IconTabFilters (and their content Texts) in a loop with addItem( ). abap2UI5 has no client-side control factory, so the port binds the items aggregation to a table holding the same 50 rows (Tab 1..50 / Content 1..50) and declares one IconTabFilter template with its content Text - structural-diff reports both as control extra because the original's view carries only the empty IconTabBar.
